description: This file implements a HAR (HTTP Archive) backend class for handling HTTP request/response lookup, content loading, and redirect following, primarily used in a web automation or proxy context.

classes.name: HarBackend
classes.description: A class managing HAR file responses, content loading, and redirect logic for network request simulation.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup for a URL and method, returning response data or redirect/error status.

methods.name: _loadContent
methods.description: Loads response content from file or text, returning a Buffer.

methods.name: _harFindResponse
methods.description: Finds a matching HAR entry for a given request, following redirects if necessary.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, such as closing the zip file.
